summary: Linkage Global Inc filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing an October 30, 2026 amendment to its July 17, 2025 securities purchase and registration rights agreements with an institutional holder, plus an additional senior unsecured convertible note with a $1,000,000 principal amount issued for $900,000 (10% original issue discount). The amendment restates additional-closing provisions for up to $26,500,000 aggregate principal of notes at 90% of principal, sets a $2,944,444.44 per-closing cap, and establishes an automatic $2,500,000 closing tied to a share consolidation or a $1.00 price threshold. Registration deadlines are December 1 and December 29, 2026. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation; key risks are dilution from conversion shares and the pending authorized-share increase needed for the reserve.
